body: A controversial provision prohibiting states from regulating AI, killed in Congress over the summer, came back to life
in Washington Tuesday as President Donald
Trump weighed in to support the idea
“We MUST have one Federal Standard instead of a patchwork of 50 State Regulatory Regimes,” the president wrote on Truth Social late Tuesday. “
, or pass a separate Bill, and nobody will ever be able to compete with America.”

due to pushback within the GOP caucus.
Some in the party have been vocal about looking for opportunities to re-up the measure.
Senate Commerce Chair Ted Cruz (R-Texas), a strong proponent of the moratorium, had teased trying to revive the proposal earlier this fall at a POLITICO event.
